To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Team identification and individual identification have interactive effects on team performance in R&D teams.
the effects of social capital on constraint adherence in RD teams are moderated by both team identification and individual self-differentiation.

(i) Team members who strongly identify with their work team are more likely to adhere to the team’s constraints when the team’s level of social capital is high; and (ii) team members who strongly identify as individuals are more likely to violate the team’s constraints under a high level cognitive or relational social capital.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of team identification and differentiation on performance and constraint adherence of R & D teams.
the question: How do team identification and individual identification interact with social capital in R&D teams to influence team performance?
the role of social capital in the relationship between individual differentiation, team identification, and team performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

social capital has a positive effect on team performance, and that the effect of social capital on team performance is moderated by team identification and individual identification, which is in turn moderated by team identification.
the results of this study show that the interaction between team identification and differentiation is contingent on social capital.
social capital is a positive factor in team effectiveness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the team identification of R&D team members has positive effects on team performance when the team has a high level of relational and cognitive social capital.
the social capital and team identification interact to affect team performance and individual differentiation.
team identification and individual differences in team members' cognitive and relational social capital are positively related to performance in R&D teams.
The main takeaway from our work is that
team members should be aware of the importance of both their team identification and their differentiation from other team members in order to maximize their performance.
social capital is an important factor to consider in R&D team performance.
social capital can help teams overcome the negative effect of team identification on team performance, but only when the team members have a strong sense of self.
